subject: Risk & Compliance
title: EU Anti-Money Laundering Directives
description: A 60-second lesson on EU Anti-Money Laundering Directives.

hook.text: The EU has passed six AML directives since 1991. Each one followed a scandal that exposed the last one's gaps.

buildup.text: EU AML directives set standards for customer due diligence, beneficial ownership, and reporting obligations.

discovery.text: The 6th directive, AMLD6, harmonized money laundering as a criminal offense across all member states.

twist.text: Despite six directives, the Danske Bank and Wirecard scandals showed enforcement remains uneven across Europe.

climax.text: The EU is now creating a single AML authority (AMLA) to centralize enforcement across borders.

punchline.text: Six directives. Still gaps. Now building one enforcer.

quiz.question: What is the EU creating to improve AML enforcement?
options: A new cryptocurrency for tracking money
Mandatory prison sentences for all violations
